name: GitHub Agentic Workflows
description: GitHub CLI extension that turns Markdown-defined workflows into GitHub Actions jobs run by a coding agent with guardrails.
whatItDoes: Maintainers describe repository automation such as issue triage, reports or code upkeep in natural language, and an AI engine carries it out inside GitHub Actions.
howItWorks: Each workflow is a Markdown file with YAML frontmatter for triggers, permissions, tools and engine; gh aw compile produces a locked Actions workflow. Agent jobs are read-only and sandboxed by default, with writes applied through validated safe-output jobs.

requirements.name: AI engine credentials
requirements.description: For the chosen engine, e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or Gemini

models: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Gemini engines
